en:
While investigating the Exisals, I noticed that
they have <CLT=cltSTRONG>no locks<CLT=cltNORMAL> on their cockpit hatches.

It should have been possible to get into the
cockpit, providing they could reach it.
But that's reckless, absurd, and useless...

Jump inside a moving Exisal?
That's not really possible.

No, I think it is. You would need to be
quick, agile, athletic, and stealthy...

I can think of at least one person
who fits that description.
...What? Are you implying that it's m—

Oooh, I see! And since he's a robot, he could
have some robo-communication function!
Huh? Was that...directed at me?

As I've said, my speed, agility, and strength
are equal to that of a human, if not weaker!

So I cannot fight an Exisal, and I certainly
cannot communicate with one!

The selling point of being a robot is 
being good in combat, but...poor Keebo...
...Please don't act like I drew the short straw.

Stop this pointless conversation, Shuichi.
If you want to say something, say it already.
Ah, Maki, just to confirm...

As the Ultimate Assassin, you would be able
to jump into that Exisal, correct?

...Impossible. If I could do that, I would've
turned the Exisal into scrap on the first day.

Maybe. Unless you were hiding your true
potential, in which case...

Stop messing around. Are you telling me to
prove something I can't do?
...Do you really suspect me that much?

No, actually. I'm trying to find a way to
prove that you *couldn't* be the intruder.

Fine then, I'll explain. There was another
problem that doesn't involve my talent.

You said earlier that the hatch doesn't have
a lock, but that's incorrect.

The Exisal's hatch has an <CLT=cltSTRONG>electronic lock<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
so it can't be opened from the outside.
What?
An electronic lock?

Yes, you can't open the hatch from the outside.
It's impossible to get into the cockpit.
Satisfied now?

<CLT=cltMIND>...You just made something
very clear to me, Maki.

<CLT=cltMIND>You do know something after
all, and you're hiding it from me!

How do you know there's an electronic lock
on the Exisal's hatch?

...Because I checked it during
the investigation.

That can't be true. I'm the only person
Monokuma told about those locks.
...Just you?
I see. If that's the case...

Then you lied just to confirm if I knew
about the electronic lock.
...Yes, I did, and I'm sorry.

I thought you were hiding something from
me, Maki. I was confirming my suspicion.

Now, please. Tell us the truth.
How do you know about the hatch?

When Monokuma explained it to you, I just
happened to overhear it. That's all.
You're lying, Maki.

You know about the locks because you've
been <CLT=cltSTRONG>inside one of the cockpits<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

So annoying... Do you want to die?
You're the one who's lying!

Huh? That's a suspicious thing to say. 
Are you actually the culprit, Maki?

Either way, there's an electronic lock so
you can't open the hatch from the outside.

Because of that, no one could've entered
the hangar piloting an Exisal.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like...she's never
going to admit it on her own.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's something important that she's
protecting by keeping her mouth shut.

<CLT=cltMIND>In that case, I have to
keep pushing.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to go over each piece of
evidence and find out what she's hiding!
<CLT=cltMIND>It's the only thing I can do!

Nyeeeh... Maki's saying it's impossible,
but there is a way to open the hatch.
Oh, you mean with your magic, right?

I won't say such a lame thing anymore.
I can't stay a dreamer forever...

That lock is electronic...
So won't an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Electrohammer<CLT=cltNORMAL> work on it?

That would let you stop an Exisal and open
its hatch.
Of course...my magic is also an option.
A dreamer to the end, huh?

True, with an Electrohammer, that method
might be possible...

But the Electrohammers were recharging
yesterday, so entering an Exisal would be—

Ah, wait! Not all of the Electrohammers
were being charged!

Wait, not all of the Electrohammers
were being charged!
I know because I found one.

There was a <CLT=cltSTRONG>used Electrohammer<CLT=cltNORMAL> near
Monokuma and the Exisals.

Was that Electrohammer used 
by the third party!?
Maybe they used it to disable an Exisal!
Yes, I think so.

When I saw them last afternoon, there
were <CLT=cltSTRONG>four<CLT=cltNORMAL> Exisals.
But this morning, there were only <CLT=cltSTRONG>three<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I noticed that, too. Was the missing Exisal
taken by this third party?
Nee-heehee... Shuichi is getting warmer...
How about you say the answer right now?
Who did it? Who is this third party?

<CLT=cltMIND>The identity of the
third party...

<CLT=cltMIND>The Electrohammer
gives us a clue.

<CLT=cltMIND>I saw four Exisals at the scene
yesterday when I went to meet up with Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>This morning, when we were trying
to get into the hangar, there were three.

<CLT=cltMIND>The culprit must have used the Electrohammer
<CLT=cltSTRONG>between yesterday afternoon and this morning<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's only one person among us
that I think could do that...

Kokichi...
So it was you all along...

Oh, c'mooon.
I'm talking about the third party heeere!
Try to remember...

Someone who didn't have an Electrohammer
when you guys raided the hangar...
Now, who was that again?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Maybe...Keebo...?

No, it wasn't me. I was charging it for
the plan this morning.

Were there any hammers that weren't
being charged...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Could it be...Himiko?

It's not me! If did that, I wouldn't be
able to use the hammer for our plan!

Everyone was supposed to bring
their own Electrohammer, remember?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
It couldn't be...Tsumugi, could it?

No, it wasn't me. I had my Electrohammer
this morning, didn't I?

If I had used it yesterday, it wouldn't
be charged this morning, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What's wrong, Shuichi?
Afraid to say it?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Shuichi, do you really think that's the
right person?
Try to remember...

Someone who didn't have an Electrohammer
when you guys raided the hangar...
Now, who was that again?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Who disabled the Exisal with the
Electrohammer and broke into the hangar?

Maki...you're the third party
we're looking for, aren't you?
What!? It's Maki!?
...What are you saying?
Remember what Kokichi said...

But, be careful. The Electrohammer runs
out of battery pretty quickly.

So if you use it against an Exisal, it'll run
out of juice with just one shot, got it?

The Electrohammer needs to be recharged for
24 hours after it runs out of battery.

That hammer was used last afternoon, so
it couldn't have been used this morning.

Oh, right. When we were all gathered
in the dining hall this morning...
Maki...where's your Electrohammer?

...I don't need it. I'd rather not use a weapon
I'm unfamiliar with...
...This is much better.
A knife? Well...I suppose you know best.

Maki was the only one without an
Electrohammer, wasn't she?

Knowing that, the Electrohammer I found
could only have belonged to Maki.

And that leads me to the conclusion
that Maki must be the third party.

She also knows how to assemble the crossbow
and could have returned it to her lab later.

You brought a different crossbow
than the one Kaito had, right?

Maki took two arrows and her own
crossbow from her lab...

...disabled the Exisal with an Electrohammer,
and infiltrated the hangar.

Now we just have to figure out
what happened after—
Why...are you doing this?
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?
Why...are you getting in my way?
Getting in your way? Maki, what are you—
Yes, I'm the third party.
Huh?

I admit to going into the hangar with an 
Exisal, and then shooting the crossbow.

But I didn't kill anyone!
I'm not the culprit!
